name: Sovereign Coder
description: Privacy-first daily coding loop for AIDE: fully local by default, every online touch is an explicit opt-in. Bundles the local model lane (North-Mini-Code 1.0 as the in-house sovereign agent), the agent workflow SOP, and curated plugin/skill/MCP recommendations into one installable workbench. Now ships with a sequenced workflow (intake -> plan -> build -> verify -> ship) that any plugged-in model can execute via the harness.

privacy_doctrine.notes: No route in this bundle performs network egress. Cloud lanes exist only as disabled-by-default recommendations the operator must explicitly enable.

setup: Read the aide-agent-workflow-sop skill before the first session.
Verify the recommended local models: GET /api/models shows status ready for the ids listed in recommended_models.
MCP servers install disabled. Review each entry, then trust individually before any tool call.
Online MCP entries (offline: false) require explicit consent per the egress doctrine; keep them untrusted unless the task needs them.
Optional: install aider or ck via uv for the on-parity local refactor/review pair — both run fully offline.

credo_excerpt: Earn trust through evidence, never verbal confidence alone.
Follow the assigned SOP and stop when a gate fails.
A generated answer is a proposal until Veritas validates it.
dos: Read aide-agent-workflow-sop before the first chat session.
Architect before editing (plan first, emit diff second).
Trust MCP servers one at a time, only as needed.
Prefer the in-house north-mini-code-1.0 for chat + coder.
donts: Do not approve a patch without running the diff against the user intent.
Do not enable the online MCP servers (github, netdata) without explicit consent.
Do not switch away from the offline default unless the task requires it.
Do not skip veritas gates even when the human approved the patch.
Do not use a fast model for coder role (it produces garbage on real projects).
dependencies: North-Mini-Code-1.0 GGUF on disk at E:/models/north-mini-code/
Git workspace (recommended; not required for the in-memory workflows)

steps.label: Census: confirm model, MCP, tools, memory
steps.description: Run aide-doctor to confirm the model engine is up, MCP servers are reachable, and the 30-day memory spine is healthy.

steps.label: Intake: normalize the user request + pin core blocks
steps.description: Apply the agent-workflow SOP: parse the user task, identify the workspace, set permissions, identify success criteria.

steps.label: Plan: architect mode, no file edits
steps.description: The reason-model produces a plan (constraints, files, risks, test checklist). No edits. Plan is the architect lane.

steps.label: Build: emit unified diff only
steps.description: The build-model produces a unified diff. Never direct file writes. Patch is the editor lane.

steps.label: Verify: veritas gates + independent reviewer
steps.description: Run Veritas: parse, tests, typecheck, security, path, diff scope. An independent verifier approves or blocks.

steps.label: Ship: human review + apply + journal
steps.description: The human reviews the patch (harness/credo.md oath). On approval: apply, journal to .aide/memory/, run veritas once more.

workflow.completion_criterion: all 6 steps passed veritas AND human approved the patch AND .aide/memory/sessions.jsonl updated
